title: Data Types and Data Locations
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Data Types and Data Locations and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 4: Data Types and Data Locations; it lists all 15 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 4 roadmap: Introduction to Solidity Data Types; Boolean Type; Unsigned and Signed Integer Types; Integer Sizes and Numeric Ranges; Address and Payable Address Types; Fixed-Size Byte Types; Dynamic Byte Arrays; Strings and String Operations; Fixed-Size and Dynamically Sized Types; Enums and Enumerated Values; Structs and Custom Record Types; Value Types and Reference Types; storage , memory , and calldata; Data Location Rules and Assignment Behavior; User-Defined Value Types. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
